settings.title: Time clock settings
settings.intro: Decide whether a personal device must be at the workplace to clock in. The counter POS (shared device) is never asked for a location.
settings.requireLocation: Require location when clocking in from a personal device
settings.accuracy: Position read with an accuracy of ±{accuracy} m. Do this from the workplace itself.
settings.workplaceMissing: Set the workplace location or nobody on a personal device will be able to clock in.
settings.autoCloseHelp: A working day still open after this many hours is marked for review so a manager can correct it.
settings.invalidLatitude: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90.
settings.invalidLongitude: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180.
settings.coordinatesIncomplete: Fill in both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
settings.invalidAutoClose: Enter a whole number of hours between 1 and 24.
settings.locationDenied: Location access is denied. Allow location in this browser to read the workplace position, or type the coordinates.
settings.locationDeniedInApp: Location access is denied. Allow location in your device settings to read the workplace position, or type the coordinates.
settings.readOnly: Only a manager or an administrator can change these settings.
settings.loadError: The settings could not be loaded.
settings.locationDevices: Only a device marked as personal is asked for its location; the counter POS never is. Each device is marked shared or personal on the device itself, in Settings › This device.
